headline: Paul McCartney Waves From Passing Car—With Ringo on Video Call
meta_description: Tour bus full of Beatles fans gets an unforgettable moment when Paul McCartney flags them down on Hope Street in Liverpool, with Ringo Starr joining via video…
summary_short: Dozens of Beatles fans aboard a Magical Mystery Tour bus in Liverpool experienced a once-in-a-lifetime moment when Paul McCartney waved from a passing car—and pulled out…
body:
What began as an ordinary Saturday tour through Liverpool turned magical when a busload of Beatles fans spotted Paul McCartney flagging them down from a passing car. The moment grew even more extraordinary when McCartney pulled out his phone to reveal Ringo Starr on a video call, waving at the delighted tourists. The encounter lasted about a minute on Hope Street near the Cathedral, but left the passengers—and 71-year-old tour guide Tony Curley—overwhelmed with joy.

Curley, who has been guiding the Magical Mystery Tour for a decade, recalled how the bus driver Neil noticed someone gesturing from a vehicle at a red light. When they pulled alongside, McCartney greeted them warmly: "You alright, lads?" Curley immediately grabbed the microphone to alert passengers to capture the moment, and McCartney obliged by waving to everyone on board before introducing his fellow Beatle via phone. "It probably only lasted a minute, but it was a magical coincidence," Curley told news outlets.

What makes the encounter even more remarkable is its improbability. Curley had only agreed to work that particular shift after someone called in sick—meaning the bus would have been guided by a different person had circumstances been slightly different. McCartney had last been spotted near his childhood home in 2018, filming a segment for a television program. Curley believes the legendary musician saw the tour bus approaching and decided to share a moment with the fans who travel from around the world to experience Beatles history in their hometown. "He must get a huge sense of pride seeing the bus," Curley reflected. For passengers aboard, the encounter will remain unforgettable—a genuine connection with living rock-and-roll history that no amount of planning could have arranged.
quick_facts: Paul McCartney waved from passing car on Hope Street, Liverpool
Ringo Starr appeared on video call during the encounter
Tour guide Tony Curley, 71, had filled in after coworker called sick
Magical Mystery Tour bus guides Beatles fans through Liverpool
Last McCartney sighting on this route was in 2018
